Apply cleaning rules and record every change

Source: R/audit.R
clean_vcs.Rd

Evaluates each rule against the relevant table, applies its action, and returns the data with a vcs_audit trail attached. The raw import inside x is never touched.

clean_vcs(x, rules = vcs_default_rules(), dry_run = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

rules

A vcs_ruleset(). Defaults to vcs_default_rules(), which only flags.

dry_run

Evaluate the rules and build the log, but leave the data unchanged. Useful for reviewing what a ruleset would do.

Value

x, with flag columns and/or modified values, and an audit element of class vcs_audit.

See also

audit_changes(), export_cleaning_log(), vcs_rule()

Examples

cleaned <- clean_vcs(vcs_example)
audit_changes(cleaned)
#> # A tibble: 180 × 11
#>    record_id    level variable original_value new_value rule_id rule_description
#>    <chr>        <chr> <chr>    <chr>          <chr>     <chr>   <chr>           
#>  1 CH00571/MCV1 vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_F… Card date is af…
#>  2 CH05241/MCV1 vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_F… Card date is af…
#>  3 CH05991/MCV1 vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_F… Card date is af…
#>  4 CH00121/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#>  5 CH00181/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#>  6 CH00301/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#>  7 CH00531/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#>  8 CH01321/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#>  9 CH01591/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#> 10 CH01691/BCG  vacc… flag_da… NA             TRUE      DATE_P… Card date is be…
#> # ℹ 170 more rows
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: severity <fct>, action <chr>, timestamp <chr>,
#> #   package_version <chr>
summary(cleaned$audit)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   rule_id           action severity n_records n_changes
#>   <chr>             <chr>  <chr>        <int>     <int>
#> 1 DATE_PREBIRTH     flag   CRITICAL        54        54
#> 2 CARD_DATE_NO_CARD flag   ERROR           17        17
#> 3 DATE_FUTURE       flag   ERROR            3         3
#> 4 DATE_UNPARSEABLE  flag   ERROR            2         2
#> 5 DATE_PARTIAL      flag   WARNING        104       104

# Nothing is changed by the default ruleset: it flags only.
identical(cleaned$vaccinations$card_date, vcs_example$vaccinations$card_date)
#> [1] TRUE
